additional_info.subject: RE: 0413193 - ID0413193-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / R0 170002841] outlet 1 error CRM:00440000328
additional_info.body:
Hello Lukas,
FYI, Reason for handover and findings were duly shared:
Out1 error active, LEM working
Outlet is not made inoperative
Customer gave timestamp for: 17 th March 8.27 am local time -→ 7: 27 UTC
Unable to find DC1 charging session successful since 1 month
Suspect EgoG  / Statemonitor issue.
EcoG logs -→
[ ERROR - 2025-03-19T10:38:05.918Z ] identity of local station is unknown
To clarify my analyses:
As the child case was created on 19th, you see a charging session on 20th.
EgoG logs were checked too last session was found on 11 and 12 feb for which EgoG were again not available, additionally when discussed all the findings with ES a child case creation was requested from one of experts in order to take it up in the EgoG meeting supposed to happen on 20th.
I hope your concerns are answered.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavy Gurav
